title: 第1章 风起云涌 许景明
content_zh:
第1章风起云涌许景明
蓝星2081年7月2日13:50，夏国最繁华城市‘滨海市’，此时乌云密布，雷声轰隆，眼看着一场暴雨要来。
“夏天的雷阵雨，说来就来。”星空格斗馆顶层的一个房间，一名年轻人正透过落地窗看着外面的乌云闪电，“噼里啪啦”开始有雨滴拍打在窗户玻璃上。
年轻人走到房间中央，双手撑地，很缓慢也很稳地进行倒立。先是双手直倒立，后收起了一只手，变成了右手的单手倒立。
“呼~~~吸~~~”
呼吸声在耳边响起，许景明感觉着身体核心肌肉群收紧，也感受着全身重量对右臂的刺激。
前三分钟手臂很舒服，手臂的筋骨肌肉被深层次刺激着，但第四分钟手掌肌肉就有些抽痛有些煎熬了，第五分钟更是痛苦，但许景明早就习惯了，坚持完五分钟，自然而然换成了左手单手倒立。
“老爸的腰，不知道今天有没有好点。”单手倒立时，许景明思绪也在飘着，他想到了父亲。父亲今年六十，腰伤是老毛病了，昨天听老妈电话里说父亲搬重物时腰伤又发了……
“等忙完最近这一阵，回老家一趟。”许景明想着。
单手倒立，不是国家队教的训练方法，而是小时候父亲教的。
许景明小时候身体不好，父亲教他武术强身健体，其中就有“单臂倒立桩”。因为长期练习效果挺好，也成了他每日练的五大桩功之一，冬练三九，夏练三伏，练习至今已有二十年，即便生病受伤也会坚持，没太特殊原因是不会断的。俗话说‘练拳不练功，到老一场空’，这所谓的功，就是日常基本功。
有个三五天中断，筋骨肌肉等各方面就会下滑。
单臂倒立桩练完后，许景明走到书桌旁坐了下来，喝了几口水，看着窗户外的暴雨。
“湿气一重，我这腿就开始疼了。”许景明看向自己的右腿，伸手轻轻揉了揉，“每天康复性锻炼从来没停过，但我的右腿……好不了了。”
“如果右腿没伤，我应该有望冲击世界第一吧。”许景明默默道。
伤病是每个武道高手职业生涯最怕遇到的。“断腿”之伤，对许景明而言，那就是一场噩梦。
“滴滴滴……”忽然有声响响起。
许景明抬起头，开口道：“小白，接视频电话。”
有光线在许景明前方凝聚，汇聚成两米高的画面，画面中一名魁梧大胖子正坐在车上，笑着喊道：“老许，我们已经从酒店出发了，估计20分钟左右就能抵达你们星空格斗馆。哈哈，我们一年多没见了吧，今晚可得好好喝一杯。”
“放心吧，大熊，我早就定好了一家烤肉餐厅。”许景明看到少年时的好友，笑着嘱托道，“雨下得挺大，你们路上小心点。”

“放心放心。”魁梧大胖子接着道，“省集训队这群小子都很崇拜你，想要见识见识你的枪法呢，等会儿你可得好好指点指点他们，让他们明白和世界顶级高手的差距。”
“现在年轻人是一代比一代厉害，我不翻船就不错了。”许景明笑呵呵道。
“怎么可能翻船？我倒是希望你能翻船，你翻船了，代表我们省队又出了一个天才啊。”大胖子哈哈笑道，“好了，不闲聊了，我们待会儿见。”
“待会见。”许景明伸手一划，半空中的画面散去。
为江南省集训队进行培训，为期十天，收取费用五万蓝星币，实际上这点钱连场地费都不够。但对格斗馆而言，能够为省集训队做培训，也是广告招牌，也能吸引更多格斗爱好者们来格斗馆办会员。
“职业选手退役，也得赚钱啊。”许景明起身，去洗澡换衣服了。
格斗职业选手听起来风光，但实际上也就巅峰时赚些‘出场费’，职业生涯收入过亿的，全世界都少得可怜，大多数职业选手也就一个温饱。
至于退役之后，赚钱就更难。许景明虽然也是世界级武道高手，但世界武道大赛，他最高也只是八强罢了。格斗界收入是成金字塔形的，塔尖的是极少极少数！排名第一的收入高得夸张，第二第三第四……会直线下滑。
许景明站在星空格斗馆门口等着，身边也有几名工作人员陪着，远远看到雨幕中有一辆电动大巴车驶来。
待得电动大巴车停下，车门
“大熊。”许景明一眼看到最先下车的魁梧大胖子，那是自己的好兄弟刘冲远。
“老许。”刘冲远走过来兴奋和许景明拥抱，嘭嘭嘭大巴掌拍在许景明背上，许景明苦着脸，也只能当是按摩了。
刘冲远，身高两米零三，体重超过一百八十公斤，好似一头直立的大熊。当年也是职业级武道高手，一手盾牌一手斧头，世界武道联盟积分排名最高的时候，也曾杀到第39位，所以在省体育局能坐稳位置。
“这位就是许教练。”刘冲远咧嘴说道，“你们朝思暮想的许教练！”
“许景明！”
“枪魔许景明！”
“看到真人了！”省队队员们都有些兴奋，作为业内人士，自然崇拜这位前辈。
许景明看着这些队员们，仿佛看到了当年的自己。
年轻，充满朝气！
哪像自己，在武道赛事闯荡，带着一身伤只能退役。

许景明笑着：“阿晨，带他们去选下兵器。”
“是，许哥。”年轻工作人员应道。
“大熊，我们先去三楼等他们。”许景明和刘冲远这一对好兄弟，开心先去三楼。
星空格斗馆的兵器室足有五百平米，刀、枪、剑、棍、盾、斧、锤、链枷等各种冷兵器数量惊人，这些都是武道比赛用具，比如刀剑，不但不开锋，表层还包裹着一层缓冲材料，大大提高安全程度。像长枪，这些比赛用枪的枪杆上有数据：长度、大小头直径、重量，长枪足有数百杆，一字排开靠墙摆放。
“不愧是星空格斗馆，滨海市一流的格斗馆，兵器够齐的。”省集训队十一名队员，都是用长枪的，所以才参加许景明的培训。
单论枪法，历史上所有职业武道高手，许景明公认是前十。
比赛长枪数据明确，十一名队员迅速选好自己常用兵器。
“第一次现实中看到许景明，看起来很普通啊，没视频中的威慑力。”一名高大男子试了试长枪，同时说道。
“感觉比视频中瘦了不少。”另一名稚嫩少年说道。
“是瘦了。”一位壮硕男子点头道，“他没退役的时候，我现场看过他几次比赛，武道联盟公开的资料，他身高一米七八，体重九十三公斤。现在瘦了不少，估计最多八十五公斤。”
这些省队队员讨论着。
他们都很清楚，一米七八的身高，八十多公斤的体重对普通人而言可能略显胖。但对职业武道高手，筋骨重，肌肉比例高，却是略显瘦了些。
“体重下降，力量肯定也下降了。”
“不知道实力还有多少。”
“有些职业选手，退役后放弃训练，身体都变形了，实力也差多了。”
这些队员们议论着。
“我还想看看，自己和世界武道大赛选手有多少差距，谁想他体重都轻了一截，实力不知还剩几分。”壮硕男子有些不甘，他去年也是入选过一次国家集训队的，目标也是格斗界最高赛事——世界武道大赛，原本对于曾两次杀进世界武道大赛的许景明存在期待，现在却是有些失望了。
体重减轻了，许景明实力还剩多少？还有‘枪魔’当年的霸道强势吗？
“就算实力下滑了，经验还在。”身侧高大男子笑道，“指点我们还是够的。”
“说不定都不会和我们实战。”稚嫩少年嘀咕道，他们见多了老一辈教练们教导指点，能下场和他们实战的，却很少。

星空格斗馆第三层，这里有符合国际武道赛事规格的武道擂台，擂台长20米，宽20米，四周有高六米的铁丝网。
省集训队队员们走进这第三层，便看到了站在那的刘教练和许景明。
“排好队。”许景明很熟悉说道，当年他也是江南省省队队员，后来才被选拔为国家队主力队员。
这十一名队员个个手持长枪，一字排好，规规矩矩。
或许许景明退役后实力大减，可对方过去的成就，还是让这些队员们钦佩服气的，自然也很听话。
“从今天开始，我就是你们的教练，集训一共十天，除了今天的训练时间是下午，明天开始都是上午九点到十一点。”许景明目光扫过他们，“我不希望有任何人迟到早退。”
“是。”十一名队员都齐声应道。
“好，我们初次见面，先下场试试手，让我看看你们的实力。”许景明说道，“我也好因材施教。”
“下场试试手？”这些队员们面面相觑，又惊又喜。
“擂台实战？”
“许景明有胆量实战？”这些队员们难掩喜色，既然许景明敢这么做，便代表退役后，还保持着巅峰时大部分实力。
————

Chapter 1 The storm is rising Xu Jingming
Blue Star At 13:50 on July 2, 2081, the most prosperous city in Xia Kingdom, Binhai City, was covered with dark clouds, thunder was booming, and a heavy rain was about to come.
"Thunderstorms in the summer are here to stay." In a room on the top floor of the Star Fighting Arena, a young man was looking at the dark clouds and lightning outside through the floor-to-ceiling windows. Raindrops began to patter on the window glass.
The young man walked to the center of the room, put his hands on the ground, and performed a handstand very slowly and steadily. First, he stood in a handstand with both hands straight, and then he put one hand away and turned into a one-handed handstand with his right hand.
"Huh~~~Breathe~~~"
The sound of breathing rang in his ears, and Xu Jingming felt the core muscles of his body tighten, and also felt the stimulation of his right arm by his whole body's weight.
In the first three minutes, the arms were very comfortable, and the muscles of the arms were deeply stimulated. However, in the fourth minute, the muscles of the palms felt a little painful and painful. In the fifth minute, it was even more painful. But Xu Jingming had long been used to it. After holding on for five minutes, he naturally switched to a one-handed handstand with his left hand.
"Dad's waist, I don't know if it feels better today." While standing on one hand, Xu Jingming's thoughts were also wandering, and he thought of his father. My father is sixty years old and has a long-standing problem with back injuries. Yesterday, I heard my mother say on the phone that my father had another back injury when he was lifting heavy objects...
"After I'm done with this recent period, I'll go back to my hometown." Xu Jingming thought.
One-hand handstand is not a training method taught by the national team, but taught by my father when I was a child.
Xu Jingming was in poor health when he was a child. His father taught him martial arts to strengthen his body, including "one-arm handstand". Because the long-term practice effect is very good, it has become one of the five major exercises he practices every day. He practices Sanjiu in winter and Sanfu in summer. He has been practicing for twenty years. Even if he is sick or injured, he will persist. Unless there is no special reason, he will not stop. As the saying goes, "Practice boxing without practicing Kung Fu, and you will be in vain". This so-called Kung Fu is the basic daily Kung Fu.
If there is a break of three to five days, the muscles, muscles and other aspects will decline.
After finishing practicing the one-arm handstand, Xu Jingming walked to his desk and sat down, drank some water and looked at the heavy rain outside the window.
"As soon as the humidity gets heavy, my leg starts to hurt." Xu Jingming looked at his right leg and stretched out his hand to rub it gently. "I have never stopped doing rehabilitative exercises every day, but my right leg...can't get better."
"If my right leg is not injured, I should be expected to be ranked No. 1 in the world." Xu Jingming said silently.
Injuries are what every martial arts master fears most in their career. The "broken leg" injury was a nightmare for Xu Jingming.
"Didi..." Suddenly there was a sound.
Xu Jingming raised his head and said, "Xiao Bai, answer the video call."
There was light condensing in front of Xu Jingming, converging into a two-meter-high picture. In the picture, a burly fat man was sitting in the car, shouting with a smile: "Old Xu, we have already set off from the hotel. We estimate that we will arrive at your Starry Sky Fighting Gym in about 20 minutes. Haha, we haven't seen each other in more than a year. We need to have a good drink tonight."
"Don't worry, Daxiong, I have already booked a barbecue restaurant." Xu Jingming saw his childhood friend and asked with a smile, "It's raining hard, so be careful on the road."
"Don't worry, don't worry." The burly fat man continued, "These boys in the provincial training team all admire you and want to see your marksmanship. Later you have to give them some pointers to let them understand the gap between them and the world's top masters."
"Nowadays, young people are getting better and better from generation to generation. It will be good if I don't capsize." Xu Jingming said with a smile.
"How can the boat capsize? I hope you can capsize. If you capsize, it means that another genius has appeared in our provincial team." The big fat man laughed and said, "Okay, no more chatting, we will see you later."
"See you later." Xu Jingming stretched out his hand and the scene in mid-air disappeared.
Conduct training for the Jiangnan Provincial training team for a period of ten yearsOh my God, the fee is 50,000 Blue Star Coins. In fact, this amount of money is not even enough for the venue fee. But for the fighting gym, it can provide training for the provincial training team, which is also an advertising sign, and can also attract more fighting fans to come to the fighting gym to become a member.
"Professional players have to make money when they retire." Xu Jingming got up and went to take a shower and change clothes.
Professional fighting players may sound glamorous, but in fact they only earn some "appearance fees" at their peak. There are very few in the world who earn more than 100 million in their careers, and most professional players only earn a living.
As for making money after retirement, it will be even harder. Although Xu Jingming is also a world-class martial arts master, in the World Martial Arts Competition, he was only among the top eight. The income in the fighting world is shaped like a pyramid, and those at the top are very few! The income of those ranked first is exaggeratedly high, while those ranked second, third, and fourth... will plummet.
Xu Jingming stood waiting at the entrance of the Star Fighting Gym, accompanied by several staff. From a distance, he saw an electric bus approaching in the rain.
When the electric bus stopped, the door
"Big Bear." Xu Jingming glanced at the burly fat man who got out of the car first. That was his good brother Liu Chongyuan.
"Old Xu." Liu Chongyuan came over and hugged Xu Jingming excitedly. He slapped Xu Jingming on the back with a big bang bang bang. Xu Jingming had a grimace and could only treat it as a massage.
Liu Chongyuan is 2.03 meters tall and weighs over 180 kilograms. He looks like an upright bear. He was also a professional martial arts master back then, with a shield in one hand and an ax in the other. When he was ranked the highest in the World Martial Arts League, he reached 39th place, so he could secure his position in the Provincial Sports Bureau.
"This is Coach Xu." Liu Chongyuan grinned and said, "The Coach Xu that you have been dreaming about!"
"Xu Jingming!"
"Gun Demon Xu Jingming!"
"I saw a real person!" The members of the provincial team were a little excited. As people in the industry, they naturally admired this senior.
Xu Jingming looked at these team members as if he saw himself back then.
Young and full of vitality!
It's not like him, who competed in martial arts competitions and had to retire with injuries.
Xu Jingming smiled: "Ah Chen, take them to choose weapons."
"Yes, Brother Xu." The young staff member responded.
"Daxiong, let's go to the third floor to wait for them first." Xu Jingming and Liu Chongyuan, good brothers, happily went to the third floor first.
The weapons room of the Star Fighting Gym covers an area of ​​500 square meters. There are an astonishing number of knives, guns, swords, sticks, shields, axes, hammers, flails and other cold weapons. These are all tools for martial arts competitions, such as swords. Not only do they not open, but they are also covered with a layer of cushioning material, which greatly improves safety. Like long guns, the barrels of these competition guns have data on them: length, head diameter, and weight. There are hundreds of long guns, lined up against the wall.
"As expected of the Starry Sky Fighting Gym, a first-class fighting gym in Binhai City, with enough weapons." The eleven members of the provincial training team all use long guns, so they participated in Xu Jingming's training.
When it comes to marksmanship alone, among all professional martial arts masters in history, Xu Jingming is recognized as one of the top ten.
The statistics of the spears in the competition were clear, and the eleven team members quickly selected their commonly used weapons.
"This is the first time I see Xu Jingming in real life. He looks very ordinary. He is not as intimidating as in the video." A tall man tried the spear and said at the same time.
"I feel a lot thinner than in the video." Another young boy said.
"He has lost weight." A strong man nodded. "Before he retired, I watched him compete several times live. According to the information released by the Martial Arts Alliance, he is 1.78 meters tall and weighs 93 kilograms. He has lost a lot of weight now, and he is estimated to be at most 85 kilograms."
These provincial team members were discussing.
They all know that a height of 1.78 meters and a weight of more than 80 kilograms may be a bit fat for ordinary people. But for a professional martial arts master, who has heavy bones and a high muscle ratio, he looks a little thinner.
"Weight loss, strength definitelyalso dropped. "
“I don’t know how much strength I still have. "
“Some professional players give up training after retirement, their bodies are deformed, and their strength is much worse. "
The team members were discussing.
"I also want to see how far I am from the World Martial Arts Competition competitors. Who would have thought that he has lost a lot of weight, and I don't know how much strength he has left. "The burly man was a little reluctant. He was selected into the national training team last year, and his goal was the World Martial Arts Competition, the highest competition in the fighting world. He originally had expectations for Xu Jingming, who had entered the World Martial Arts Competition twice, but now he is a little disappointed.
After losing weight, how much strength does Xu Jingming have left? Is there still the domineering strength of the ‘Gun Demon’ back then?
“Even if the strength has declined, the experience is still there. The tall man beside him smiled and said, "Guiding us is enough." "
“Maybe they won’t even fight us. "The immature boy murmured. They had seen a lot of guidance from the older generation of coaches, but very few could get off the field and actually compete with them.
On the third floor of the Star Fighting Arena, there is a martial arts arena that meets the specifications of international martial arts competitions. The arena is 20 meters long and 20 meters wide, and is surrounded by a six-meter-high barbed wire fence.
The members of the provincial training team walked into the third floor and saw Coach Liu and Xu Jingming standing there.
“Get in line. "Xu Jingming said very familiarly. He was also a member of the Jiangnan Provincial Team back then, and was later selected as a main player of the national team.
Each of these eleven team members held long spears and lined up in an orderly manner.
Maybe Xu Jingming's strength has been greatly reduced after his retirement, but the other team members' past achievements still make these players admire and admire them, and they are naturally very obedient.
"Starting today, I will be your coach. There will be a total of ten days of training. Except that today's training time is in the afternoon, starting tomorrow it will be from 9 to 11 am. Xu Jingming glanced at them, "I don't want anyone to be late or leave early." "
"yes. "All eleven team members responded in unison.
"Okay, this is our first meeting. Let's go down and try your hand first, let me see your strength. "Xu Jingming said, "I can teach students in accordance with their aptitude. "
"Try your hand next time? "The team members looked at each other, surprised and happy.
"Actual combat in the arena? "
"Does Xu Jingming have the guts to fight? "These team members couldn't hide their joy. Since Xu Jingming dared to do this, it means that after retirement, he still maintains most of his peak strength.
